scope: Add whole-write rollback/retry/readback coverage for two legacy compound entity routes across accepted pre-R2018 DXF writer revisions AC1014 through AC1024.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored records generated during the test
source.profile: One classic POLYLINE with two VERTEX children, a bulge, and SEQEND; one INSERT with two standalone non-MTEXT ATTRIB children and SEQEND. Tested in ASCII and Binary for AC1014, AC1015, AC1018, AC1021 and AC1024.

implementation.change: The focused legacy compound-entity sweep now writes both the INSERT/ATTRIB/SEQEND chain and POLYLINE/VERTEX/SEQEND chain for all accepted legacy writer revisions in the matrix.
implementation.method: For each version and codec, calibrate allocations in a successful whole dxfRW::write, inject std::bad_alloc at each reached allocation, verify failure and prior destination preservation, preserve caller entities, ensure no staged file remains, retry on the same codec to byte-identical output, and freshly parse both compound entities. Typed readback checks attributes, polyline geometry/bulge, distinct remapped parent/vertex handles, and a nonzero SEQEND handle.

validation.allocationOffsets: 1330/1330 injected allocation failures pass rollback/retry/typed-readback across five versions and two codecs.
validation.diffCheck: PASS: git diff --check on implementation, plan and receipt paths

limitations: Generated transport/transaction evidence only; producer interoperability and native consumer behavior are not qualified.
The polyline profile uses two ordinary vertices and one bulge; meshes, polyfaces, widths, spline-fit variants and richer vertex XDATA profiles remain outside this slice.
AC1012 whole-write output remains refused with BAD_VERSION as recorded in the [AC1014 receipt](p6-dxf-ac1014-attributed-insert-allocation-rollback-retry-2026-11-13.json).

planImpact.completedSlice: AC1014/AC1015/AC1018/AC1021/AC1024 whole-write allocation rollback, same-codec retry and typed readback for standalone attributed INSERT and classic POLYLINE compound chains.
planImpact.remainingP6G: Continue with distinct public-writer overloads, other compound-record variants, variable-size OBJECTS builders, and uncovered caller-state combinations.
